calls.reason: In 2025, OpenAI's CFO said AGI was getting close, SoftBank tied a $40B investment and Stargate to reaching AGI, and Meta called superintelligence in sight while building infrastructure. Stargate sites were already running. The UK plan's hedged rationale only narrows the claim.

ARC-AGI-2 and ARC-AGI-3 show large gaps on new reasoning and interactive tasks, but models scored at gold-medal level on astronomy olympiad exams. AGI and 'close' are undefined, so the evidence is mixed and the claim can't be called.
